hook.name: V4rcadeFeeHook
hook.description: Single-pool hook with dynamic LP fees and an owner-adjustable base fee. Restricts liquidity to allowlisted providers in full-range positions only. Optionally applies fee discounts via EIP-712-signed vouchers passed in hookData. Collects a fee from token-to-ETH exact-input swaps by donating back to the pool in afterSwap.
